analysis: Retain every cell, all full states, twin growth and six-step direction cosines. Audit raw recurrence candidates through192, both exponent halves and token cycles. Apply the same six-phase coding/straightness gates as the mother paper and distinguish ordinal branch words from critical-point kneading sequences. Compare eligible cyclic derivative-sign words with the existing quadratic-family MSS catalogue through return-period7. A finite65-point cut cannot prove exhaustive window order or global conjugacy; periodicity remains a recurrence candidate unless separately Newton-qualified. Fit no continuous map to periodic point sets.
resources: One owned A100 SXM80GB, eight threads,130 simultaneous base/twin rows. Existing BSP3 measured1024-cell blocks in about410seconds for1768steps; budget conservatively45-minute shell and65-minute setup/run, hard90-minute lifetime including20-minute retrieval reserve. About1.4GB raw state array; retrieve/hash and verify exact shutdown. Independent watchdog; no automatic retry. Cost: see private ledger.
